title: Карбоновый гравийник Pardus из коробки

takeaways.text: Uragano Sport with Shimano 105 2×11 and mechanical Tektro disc brakes, alloy 420 mm bar and alloy seatpost; cables run internally through the headset cover with a separate hole for each line.
The wheels arrived with very loose spokes and a slightly out-of-true rim, so he retensioned both; the rear rotor rubbed slightly and the bar tape is very cheap.
The size-XL bike weighed about 9.76 kg without pedals.
With 40 mm tires fitted he judges 42 mm will fit and 45 mm, the official maximum, would be tight; 46/30 chainrings could be swapped for 50/34.

disclosure: A Russian workshop assembling the bike for sale or a customer; no sponsorship is stated. Russian automatic captions.
summary: A workshop unboxing and build of a size-XL PARDUS Uragano Sport with Shimano 105 and mechanical disc brakes.
